t: Flying up front:Upgrade fee may be more or less then up-faring/purchase directly,Why? - FlyerTalk Forums
s: December 8, 2024 - Nearly 100% of my HNL-LAX or HNL-SFO or vice versa buyups are $350 regardless of the F price which is always cheaper than buying F outright. ... Quite the opposite: UA calculates domestic upgrade prices based on the differential from Y to F. This can sometimes result in a discount to the current F fare because it calculates based on the theoretical difference rather than the actual differential.
